result.brief: 提出 CoRe，用连续流在共享的理解表征空间中联合训练图像与文本的理解和生成，无需预训练 VAE 或语言模型，并证明生成可增强表征信息量。
result.reason: Trains shared contextual image/text representations from scratch where generation flows in the understanding space, directly addressing unified understanding-generation representations without pretrained VAE or encoders.
